title: Starfall
intent: Complete standalone game and deliberate NGNE engine exercise

engine.integration: Published package, exact pin, public exports only

target: Web; WebGPU-capable browser on localhost or HTTPS
experience: Omnidirectional arcade shoot-em-up retaining the demo's movement, auto-fire, optional manual aim, chain scoring and rechargeable Nova; three authored stages replace timed survival victory.

stages.name: Orbital Breakwater
stages.setting: Cobalt planet horizon and orbital docks
stages.boss: Gatebreaker: armored carrier, side turrets, fan shots and exposed core

stages.name: Furnace Belt
stages.setting: Copper asteroids and damaged industrial machinery
stages.encounters: Crossing formations, mine layers and repositioning hazards
stages.boss: Kiln Serpent: segmented mining machine with sweeping movement and destructible sections

stages.name: Midnight Citadel
stages.setting: Violet fortress above a luminous star
stages.encounters: Elite escorts, combined formations and telegraphed danger lanes
stages.boss: Starfall Engine: destructible emitters, three attack phases and cascading destruction

rules: Five hull points, brief damage invulnerability, repair pickups and a consistent small player collision radius
Rechargeable Nova clears nearby threats; ordinary kills reward better chain scoring
Stage bosses gate progression; final boss defeat completes the campaign
Immediate stage retry restores stage-entry score and full hull; local best score and settings persist
Difficulty and Nova recharge are tuned through playtesting

controls.keyboard: WASD/arrows move, automatic shooting, Space triggers Nova, Escape pauses
controls.gamepad: Left stick moves, right stick aims, face button triggers Nova, Start pauses
controls.menus: Keyboard/pointer/controller navigation; canvas-rendered focus and controls

presentation.shell: Game fills browser window; all normal menus, HUD, pause, settings and results are canvas-rendered. Optional native fullscreen action. Aspect-preserving game-colored letterboxing when needed.
presentation.art: Original NEOGEO-inspired pixel art: substantial shaded machinery, readable silhouettes, bright metal highlights, animated exhaust, layered scenery and authored explosion frames
presentation.palette: Cyan player, warm friendly shots, coral enemy bullets; subdued backgrounds protect combat readability
presentation.audio: Synth/FM-inspired stage music, boss cues, punchy weapon/impact sounds and result stingers
settings: Reduced motion suppressing shake and intense flashes
presentation.artGate: Actual representative scene at intended display scale, including motion, before expanding production

engineProofs: Schema ECS and chunk queries for ships, projectiles and effects with buffered entity lifetime
Fixed-step simulation and named RNG streams separating gameplay from effects
WebGPU atlas sprites, tint, alpha, rotation and layer/depth ordering
Camera movement, pixel snapping and render interpolation
Scene freeze with effects continuing during hit-stop
Prepared scenes and candidate slots for levels, pause and retry
Scene asset leases and cleanup across repeated transitions
Scoped audio, fades and pause ducking
Browser input focus and cancellation-safe menu activation

architecture.scenes: Compose entities, systems, assets and audio
architecture.world: Encounter state, collision queries and non-ECS simulation
architecture.assets: Images, atlas metadata, audio and manifest
architecture.ui: Canvas bitmap text, panels, focus and screens
architecture.services: Browser display, persistence and audio adapters

constraints: Collision, progression, animation, bitmap text and parallax are consumer-owned
No assumed bloom, custom shader or additive-blending API; effects use verified public primitives
Original demo background is non-seamless and is not a scrolling environment asset
Mobile/touch and physical gamepad support are not established by desktop browser evidence
